component.name: Jump
component.summary: Search applications, windows, files, and clipboard

description.p: Jump is a launcher for the COSMIC desktop. It opens as an overlay above everything else and searches applications, open windows, files by name, file contents, and clipboard history from one field.

An empty query shows Launchpad — every installed application in a grid. Typing switches to search. Results from different providers are ranked on one scale, so a file you asked for by name is not buried under applications that happen to mention it.

ul.li: Animated overlay with compositor backdrop blur
Launchpad grid, full screen or panelled, paged or scrolling
Window switching, with matches ranked above launching a second copy
File search over a private index, with optional full-text search
Alfred-style plugins, plus every pop-launcher plugin already installed
